answer: A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. To join, a name must pass Professed hammer maker tannery writ, which works because a writ makers sign after forge audits. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The anchor is small, but the toll is a toll of 9 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. dawn stays on the record.
